Supreme Court Rules: AI-Generated Content is Free from Copyright UNLESS Substantial Human Modification is Proven

The U.S. Supreme Court has issued a landmark ruling on AI copyright: content generated entirely by AI is now considered public domain unless 'substantial human modification' can be proven.
